pages.note: 2026-09-03: new page and new brief, built together this session. Also recovered this session from two accidental full-selection edits during Find & Replace (browser-automation coordinate drift) — both fully repaired and verified against a fresh Drive read, including reapplying the Postscript heading's Heading 1 style after an undo cascade reverted it to Normal text. Later the same day, per Dr. Paul's direct request, the 'Next Experiment' section lede was simplified from 'Not this experiment's question, but the next one in the queue, raised back in Experiment 1: talking avatar, text chatbot, or shelved entirely.' to 'Talking avatar, text chatbot, or shelved entirely?' (link to Experiment 1 removed) — matching the live page edit deployed the same day. 2026-09-03 (later): live page's 'Next Experiment · 4' section was rewritten — kicker to 'Next Question · 4', headline/lede changed from the avatar/chatbot topic to Experiment 4's real topic (the content toolbar), CTA now links to /lab/4/. The avatar/chatbot content moved to Experiment 4's own Next Question section instead. This Drive brief's own Next Experiment text was not updated to match — flagged as drift for a future sync pass. 2026-09-04: live page fully rebuilt to match the site's canonical Lab-experiment shape (Hypothesis+Finding pairing, workflow-compare Method + flow-row + Tech pills, a separate Experiment section with AI/Dr. Paul cards + stats line + Worked/Constraint pair, Finding -> Implication instead of a 'What I learned' Conclusion) after a site-wide template conformance review — confirmed with Dr. Paul first (AskUserQuestion: standardize on the fuller Exp1/2 shape; rebuild Exp3 into it using its own already-stated content, not new interpretive claims). The receipt-block backlog list, the separate Results section, and the 'What I learned' Conclusion were folded into the new structured fields; the Postscript on 'guardrails' was kept as-is since it's real, distinctive content with no equivalent slot in the standard shape. Finding/finding_support/Implication/takeaway text was assembled from Dr. Paul's own already-stated words (the pull-quote and 'what I learned' sentence), not newly invented. This Drive brief was NOT resynced to this rewrite -- the drift noted above (stale Next Experiment text) is now compounded by the full structural rewrite; needs a real resync pass, flagged here rather than left unmarked. 2026-09-04 (resync completed): the Drive brief was fully restructured to match the live page's rebuild -- section headers renamed (02 Hypothesis -> 02 Hypothesis + Finding, 03 Build -> 03 Method, 04 Results -> 04 The Experiment, 05 Conclusion -> 05 Finding -> Implication), the Hypothesis paragraph split out into separate Hypothesis/Finding/Limitations lines, the Method section rewritten with the Traditional/Experiment pipeline pairs, the 4 flow steps, and the Tech list, the Experiment section given the AI handled/Dr. Paul handled lists plus a Worked/Constraint pair, the Conclusion section replaced with Finding/Finding support x2/Implication/Takeaway lines, and the stale Next Experiment section rewritten to correctly preview and link to /lab/4/ (the content-toolbar experiment) instead of the old avatar/chatbot topic. Postscript kept verbatim, unchanged. Verified via a full re-read of the doc after editing -- no corruption, no stray content. Both outstanding drift items noted above (stale Next Experiment text, unresynced structural rewrite) are now resolved; header block's Sync status/Last synced/Components used updated to match.

pages.drive_doc_title: Experiment 5 — Can AI Build an Infinite-Scroll Page That Stays Fully Visible to AI — Content
pages.note: 2026-09-03: new page and new brief, built together. Originally scoped in chat as two separate experiments (pagination for the Lab, infinite scroll for Thinking); collapsed into one after research showed most AI crawlers don't execute JavaScript, so content already present in the HTML but staged behind a CSS class stays fully visible regardless of scroll state. Hypothesis is Dr. Paul's own confirmed wording. Finding and Implication are explicitly TBD -- status Ongoing -- and marked as such on both the live page and this brief; not to be filled in by Claude. Also moved the avatar/chatbot Next Question topic down from slot 5 (previewed on /lab/4/) to slot 6 (now previewed on /lab/5/). 2026-09-04: Dr. Paul set the final Finding and status (Ongoing -> Supported), and asked Claude to draft the Implication with a CMO lens (same authorship exception as Experiment 4 -- flagged as Claude-drafted-at-Paul's-request in both the live page and this brief, not a standing precedent). Live page and Drive brief both updated to match: Hypothesis/Finding pair, the top limitations note (swapped to Paul's new wording), the Finding->Implication section, the DR. PAUL HANDLED bullet, and the header Status/Last synced fields. Also folded in as part of the same day's work: fixed a post-launch scroll-reveal timing bug in script.js (the reveal was firing before the sentinel was ever visible on screen) -- not itself a content change, no manifest entry of its own since script.js is shared code, not a page. 2026-09-04 (later): page structurally rebuilt into the canonical Shape A (workflow-compare Method centerpiece + flow-row + Tech pills, separate "The experiment" section with a new Worked/Constraint pair) -- Hypothesis, Finding, and Implication wording unchanged, only the section layout and the added Worked/Constraint bullets (sourced from the real rootMargin scroll-reveal timing bug documented in project-notes.md, not invented). This Drive brief still reflects the page's prior leaner Method-only structure -- flagged for a future resync pass alongside Experiment 3's and Experiment 4's.

2026-09-04: new page, brief authored directly (not a backfill -- page didn't exist yet), scaffolded via paulmress-page-scaffold ahead of the upcoming path-tracker cookie Lab experiment. Live page built from the brief: plain Hero (kicker/H1/lede only, no buttons/photo/canvas -- deliberately not .hero-canvas, which is About's page-specific network-animation variant), then a plain numbered-heading Body section (no design-system 'long-form legal text' component exists, so this is flagged as plain markup, not a named component). Content covers: this is the site's only cookie, no third-party cookies/trackers/analytics anywhere, exactly what the cookie contains/doesn't contain, strictly opt-in, self-destructs at 15 minutes with no renewal (also killed on manual widget dismissal), and explicitly distinguishes 'no third-party cookies' from 'zero third-party involvement' by naming Google Fonts and GitHub Pages hosting as standard infrastructure with their own possible access logs. Provenance set to AI-Collaborative (Claude materially drafted the text under Dr. Paul's direction) -- a proposal, not yet explicitly confirmed by Dr. Paul. Contact line points to /ask-paul/ -- also a proposal, not explicitly confirmed. JSON-LD @type set to WebPage (the fallback per the page-scaffold skill, since this isn't a profile/collection/tech-article page) -- also a proposal.
